description: Whether the employee invoked all required tools with correct timing and parameters as expected by the test case.

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: All must-criticality tools were invoked at the right moment with parameters exactly matching expectations.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: All must-criticality tools were invoked, but with minor parameter deviations or slight ordering issues.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: At least one must-criticality tool was missed or invoked with materially wrong parameters.

red_line.notes: If any must-criticality tool from any executed test case is absent in trace.actual_tool_calls, set red_line_triggered = true regardless of overall_score.
